items.title: The relative Frobenius of a locally finite type morphism in characteristic p is finite
items.author: The Stacks Project Authors
items.source_version: Stacks Project source tree, file varieties.tex, corpus local snapshot 20261011
items.difficulty_reason: The lemma proves that for a scheme X over S in characteristic p with X -> S locally of finite type, the relative Frobenius F_{X/S} is finite. The proof translates to algebra: for a finite type homomorphism A -> B of characteristic p rings with B' = B tensor over (A, F_A) with A and F_{B/A} : B' -> B given by b tensor a maps to b^p a, the assertion is that F_{B/A} is finite (proof lines 7161-7165). Choosing generators x_1, ..., x_n of B over A, one has x_i^p = F_{B/A}(x_i tensor 1), so each generator is integral over B', and the integrality criterion for finite ring maps gives finiteness (proof lines 7166-7169). H2: the identification of the generators as integral elements over the Frobenius base change is the substance.
